shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile, low-relief, seen from the side
animal(s) carved on a flat vertical face of an upright slab/pillar
raised-relief outline with minimal interior detail
animal with elongated body and legs bent/crouching
justification: Both show low-relief animals in strict profile on the broad face of an upright slab, with the same convention of a raised silhouette with an elongated body and little interior modelling, and each includes a crouching/striding quadruped facing left. However A carries a single isolated animal on an otherwise blank field, while B is densely packed with multiple registers — a row of arch-like motifs above a banded strip with hanging elements, several animals, a bird with a snake-like form, and a disc — so the compositional programme and the relationships between elements are quite different.
